name: fix163_sunk_body
verifies: fix-163 (owner, Vengard yard: an orc body half in the dirt): a corpse rests on the ground and is shown on it again after two save/load cycles (its saved origin no longer drifts 0.5-0.8 m per load); a corpse pushed into the ground after its rest is lifted by the rest check; a station NPC pushed into the floor is put back on its slot's floor
steps: log -- an orc killed in the yard (ragdoll), then a save/load twice
log -- a fresh corpse pushed 0.6 m into the ground right after its rest: the rest check lifts it
spawn Orc_Raider_Scout_01 attitude=neutral dist=4 side=left as=o2
log -- a station NPC (orc scout at his Sit_Ground slot) pushed into the yard floor: back on the floor
notes: corpsemove = |vertical move| of the body's last settling: a corpse shown again after a load lies about where it lay: only the ground tilt (not saved, yaw only) costs ~0.1 m, the same every load; before the fix the saved origin drifted 0.5-0.9 m per load ('restored pose: moved +0,79 m'), because ReportPose is ignored for a Near NPC and the children carried the height move. corpsegap = 2nd percentile of the skin over the ground (negative = sunk). npcfootgap = feet over the column's floor (fix-108). The orc scout #826a0234 is the owner's NPC (dead in his save); in a fresh game he sits at routine point 8a1e3389 (901.5, 5.3, 426.6) by day. $o1 is a content NPC (the owner's sunk Orc_Raider_Scout_02#2e11560b): a dev spawn does not survive a load.
